long_biography.plain_text:
Electronics executive Adnan Celik explored tourism development on Montenegro’s coast through Rixos Group. On his fourth visit to Kotor in 2013, he offered company capital for a hotel, tourist complex or water park. His delegation met officials responsible for planning and property. They presented sites that the municipality wished to develop with private investors and explained the available locations.

The following year, Celik led discussions in Ulcinj about a high-category resort on Long Beach. He met mayor Fatmir Gjeka, whose administration offered to approach central government to help realise the proposed development.
